cursor-connection.title: Cursor connection checks
cursor-connection.intro: Identify local entry points and review setup steps and current support.
cursor-connection.scope: Checks entry points in the current desktop PATH only
cursor-connection.passive_boundary: Checks file presence only. No Cursor candidates are launched, software installed or models called.
cursor-connection.scope_unavailable: The current identity or project scope is unavailable. Reopen the project before checking.
cursor-connection.browser_hint: The browser cannot inspect local entry points. Read the official installation guide or check in the suma desktop app. For remote nodes, check on the target node separately.
cursor-connection.check_failed: This check could not finish. Please try again.
cursor-connection.observed_clock_hint: This is when this device received the result, not when the provider updated its status.
cursor-connection.execution_unavailable: Cursor task execution is not yet available
cursor-connection.account_boundary: Entry files, account authorization, online status and execution results require separate checks.
cursor-connection.scope_detail: Checks fixed file names in this desktop's PATH only. Does not execute candidates or read account configuration. Remote nodes require separate checks.
cursor-connection.reason_not_installed: No entry found in this check
cursor-connection.reason_not_installed_h: No Agent or editor entry was found in the current PATH. An installation may exist elsewhere.
cursor-connection.reason_cursor_editor_o: Only the Cursor editor was found
An editor entry cannot serve as an Agent execution entry. Check the Agent installation against the official guide.
cursor-connection.reason_cursor_agent_un: The file exists, but its provider identity, version, protocol and execution permissions remain unverified. It cannot receive dispatched tasks.
cursor-connection.reason_cursor_launcher: The candidate script exists, but the platform cannot use it to execute tasks. This does not confirm a working Cursor connection.
cursor-connection.reason_cursor_scan_inc: Some files could not be checked, so installation status remains unknown. Check file access permissions and try again.
cursor-connection.picker_hint: Implemented tools can connect to execution nodes; Cursor provides entry verification guidance.
